description:
Music for Mental Fatigue | Sitar Music | 1.5 Hours

Not tired enough to sleep — just mentally spent. Hours of thinking, screens, decisions, and your brain feels foggy and drained, but the day isn't done.

Start here. Ninety minutes of warm, clear sitar to lift the mental fatigue and bring you back sharp — restoring your focus, not putting you to sleep.

What you'll hear: bright, unhurried sitar over a soft pulse — open and clarifying, the feeling of fog lifting and the mind coming back online.

Best for: end-of-day mental recovery · clearing brain fog · resetting between work blocks · a quiet space and a pair of headphones.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to clear mental fatigue, restore focus, and feel sharp again.
thumbnail_prompt: Pichwai/Kangra miniature painting style, ornate warm-gold patterned border. Evening palette but LUMINOUS and CLARIFYING (not dusky-drowsy) — warm amber light with a sense of clearing/lifting, soft glow suggesting fog dissolving and clarity returning. Central figure: an alert, upright musician playing a sitar, composed and clear-eyed (restored, NOT slumped/sleepy) — body language of someone coming back to sharpness. IMPORTANT: vary the interior composition from the channel's other Sitar thumbnails so it is visually distinct in-feed (not the same painting relabeled). Overlay text 'MENTALLY DRAINED?' in dark-teal serif, large and mobile-readable (2 words, scans under 1 second). This is a Q-hook (cognitive lane = Q-hook wins). Mobile-first: minimal clutter.
suno_prompt_A: Warm clarifying Indian classical instrumental, Raga Yaman — raised teevra Ma, expansive outward open evening character, the feeling of mental fog lifting and a tired mind coming back sharp and clear, warm plucked sitar with meend glissando slides and gamak ornamentation, light tabla keeping a gentle steady pulse, soft tanpura drone, 432Hz tuning, 68 BPM, mid register, warm open airy production, seamless loop-friendly texture, like clarity returning to a drained mind, restorative not drowsy, no vocals, no humming, no human voice
suno_prompt_B: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming, warm clarifying Indian classical sitar, Raga Yaman — teevra Ma expansive open evening, warm plucked sitar with meend glides and gamak, light tabla gentle pulse, soft tanpura drone, 432Hz, 68 BPM, mid register, warm open airy production, seamless loop, like mental fog lifting and the mind coming back sharp, restorative not drowsy

production_spec.loop_seam: 10s in / 30s out, Suno extend 3-4x → loop in post to fill 90 min
production_spec.notes: CRITICAL: restorative-BRIGHT, NOT drowsy. Mental fatigue = active restoration (clear the fog, come back sharp), NOT sleep. Alpha 10Hz (relaxed alertness), mid register, 68 BPM (present, not sleepy). INCLUDE light tabla (Sitar pattern). Raga Yaman opens/lifts the tired mind rather than sedating. If the first Suno clip sounds drowsy/sleepy, regenerate — Sitar fails passive.
